data_status: All 290 respondents are development; no verified untouched local test set
feature_policy: Fixed 73 predictors; id and label excluded; no feature changes based on validation outcomes
preprocessing_policy: Fit separately on each distinct inner/outer training partition; reusing that partition's state across candidates is allowed
outer_policy: Outer predictions are made after each inner search is complete and are not inputs to candidate or hyperparameter selection
tie_policy: Accuracy differences <= 1e-12 are ties; use each adapter's declared complexity key
convergence_policy: If an estimator supports max_iter and raises ConvergenceWarning, retry the same fit once with max_iter=5000; exclude unresolved/nonfinite/failed fits from candidate selection and log them

softmax.expansion_policy: One extra candidate only: C=0.001 if the initial inner winner is 0.01; C=1000 if it is 100; otherwise none. No additional expansion after that.

artifact_policy: Save fold reference exports only; family selection and final full-data refitting wait until all three tuned families are available
limitation: Preliminary exploration informed keyword definitions before an untouched local test group could be verified; earlier feature design may make evaluation estimates optimistic.
